title: Ask the project: cited answers over the project documents
why: Retrieval-grounded assistants with citations and refusals are the standard internal-knowledge pattern.
notes: 26 hand-written questions; answers are extractive sentences.
limits: The method was changed once after seeing the first score (stop words removed from the query; a hit no longer needs the expected file; the first run scored 25.0% hits), so the final figure is optimistic.
Small, hand-written question set whose expected phrases come from the same documents.
A hit means a cited chunk contains the expected phrase, not that the answer reads well.
Refusal uses a fixed word-coverage threshold chosen once, not tuned per question.
